items.description: Each insertion fills exactly one canonical slot: mechanism unpacking, empirical evidence, comparative or methodological context, failure mode or counterview, or interpretation note.
Every empirical claim, Croatian or international, has verifiable support; geography creates no reserved zone.
No study detail, number, effect, sample size, finding, page, citation key, or source is invented.
Insertions are shown with slot, anchor, prose, and evidence before any file edit.
A verified references.bib key supports empirical prose; if the source is absent, identify the evidence needed and stop that proposal before drafting it.
A reader who already understood the chapter learns something new from the insertion.
